threat_event: Attacker in a project executive's mailbox sends an owner false remittance instructions and diverts a monthly pay application payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owners not told the verification procedure; remittance details also sent by email; lookalike domains
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for project executives; external banners; DMARC reject
treatment_plan: Standing remittance letter to every owner; remittance confirmation call on first payment to any account; validated remittance block

threat_event: Spoofed subcontractor requests a bank change before a payment run
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume (about 9,000 subcontractors); requests arrive by email
existing_controls: Call-back to a number on file and second approver in the payment factory
treatment_plan: Hold bank changes inside 10 days of a run; quarterly testing of call-back records

threat_event: Remittance block on a pay application is altered by an insider or an attacker using a project accountant's account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remittance block is free text editable by project accountants; edits not monitored
existing_controls: Pay applications reviewed by project executives (totals only)
treatment_plan: Payment-instruction service; remove edit rights; SIEM alert on remittance edits
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: Attacker changes EFT data in SAM and diverts a federal progress payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAM Entity Administrator accounts on several staff; FAR 52.232-33(e)(2) loss allocation
existing_controls: Government sign-in with MFA; weekly SAM record check
treatment_plan: Limit Entity Administrators to 3 per entity; reconcile SAM EFT data to the bank monthly

threat_event: CUI drawings from design-build projects are stored in the PDPP and commercial email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field release export; superintendents lack enclave access in trailers; no upload block
treatment_plan: Enclave desktops in trailers; purge and block (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: Field staff mishandle CUI because they do not recognize markings or know where CUI may live
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI training reaches only enclave users
treatment_plan: CUI handling module for 1,200 field staff; marking job aids in trailers

threat_event: Level 1 affirmation is inaccurate because a requirement is no longer met in the PDPP scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3,800 stale external accounts; visitor logs incomplete at some trailers
existing_controls: Annual self-assessment; Director of Federal Contracts Compliance
treatment_plan: Close gaps before the 2027-01-20 annual affirmation; counsel review

threat_event: Construction cannot compete for DoD design-build work that requires Level 2 (C3PAO) after Phase 2 begins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enclave not ready; requirements excluded from a POA&M not met
existing_controls: Final Level 2 (Self) dated 2026-03-16 under counsel review
treatment_plan: Close blocking requirements; C3PAO assessment in 2027-02 (group plan GR-03)

threat_event: A subcontractor without the required CMMC status is awarded DoD work with FCI or CUI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SPRS status check before award
treatment_plan: Status check step in prequalification; award hold until confirmed

threat_event: A compromised subcontractor sends malicious files or fraudulent pay requests through the PDPP portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External users need no MFA; files from portals scanned only by the vendor
existing_controls: Vendor malware scanning; EDR on workforce devices
treatment_plan: MFA for subcontractor administrators; payment changes only through the payment factory
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: Stale external accounts from closed projects are used to read project documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3,800 external accounts never removed at closeout
existing_controls: Quarterly review of workforce accounts only
treatment_plan: Automatic expiry at project closeout; 90-day inactivity disable for external users
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: The project management SaaS vendor has a prolonged outage or loses data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor; export restore with project teams untested
treatment_plan: Restore exercise with 3 project teams; offline drawing sets
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: Ransomware on jobsite networks and tablets halts field reporting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Jobsite networks mix company and subcontractor devices at some sites
treatment_plan: Separate subcontractor Wi-Fi at every jobsite

threat_event: TSSI installs private-label cameras made by a covered manufacturer at a federal site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening relies on distributor declarations
existing_controls: Submittal screening; approved product list for TSSI
treatment_plan: Parent-manufacturer check for private labels; group approved-manufacturer list

threat_event: Attacker steals client system credentials from the TSSI vault and disables client security systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vault holds administrator credentials for 140 managed clients
treatment_plan: Per-client vault partitions; rotate client credentials at handover; hardware-backed keys

threat_event: TSSI technician misuses remote access to a client system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Technicians have broad client access
treatment_plan: Monthly session sampling

threat_event: Federal pricing or FCI uploaded to the AI estimating assistant is exposed or pooled with competitors' data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pooled pricing feature enabled; vendor holds SOC 2 Type 1 only
existing_controls: Enterprise terms bar training on group data
treatment_plan: Disable pooled pricing; require SOC 2 Type 2; CUI upload prohibition (P10)

threat_event: AI bid leveling ranks first-time and small subcontractors lower
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Missing history scored as poor history
treatment_plan: Score missing history as neutral; show price-only ranking (P10)

threat_event: Jobsite safety computer vision misses hazards or is used to discipline workers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot at 40 jobsites without a written use limitation
treatment_plan: Use limitation (safety only, no discipline); accuracy sampling (P10)

threat_event: Certified payroll files with Social Security numbers are exposed from email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subcontractors email unmasked certified payrolls
treatment_plan: Intake through the PDPP with masked numbers; delete from mailboxes after 30 days

threat_event: Lost or stolen jobsite tablet exposes FCI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 6,000 tablets in the field
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low with current controls

threat_event: Telematics vendor compromise exposes equipment locations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor SaaS
treatment_plan: Accepted: limited impact

threat_event: Drone or progress photos of federal sites are posted publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Marketing and social media use of project photos
treatment_plan: Federal project photo exclusion in POL-05

threat_event: Field crews build from superseded drawings after a sync failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline tablet sync failures not alerted
treatment_plan: Sync failure alerts to superintendents

threat_event: Hurricane damages jobsites and trailers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many Florida and Gulf Coast jobsites
treatment_plan: Pre-season drill per region

threat_event: Section 889 representation in SAM is made without a documented reasonable inquiry
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inquiry records kept by TSSI only
treatment_plan: Documented group inquiry before each annual representation

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing captures a session of a user with number-matching MFA and reaches pay application workflows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only payment roles have phishing-resistant MFA; project managers who prepare pay applications do not
existing_controls: Risk-based sign-in policies; token protection on managed devices
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all project managers and project accountants

threat_event: An owner user without MFA is taken over and approves a fraudulent change order or pay application
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External MFA optional
treatment_plan: MFA required for owner approvers
owner: PDPP system owner (Group project delivery platform director)

threat_event: Visitors in jobsite trailers with FCI are not escorted or logged
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visitor logs incomplete at 30% of sampled trailers
treatment_plan: Electronic visitor sign-in on trailer tablets

threat_event: Federal project records and CUI copies are kept after contract closeout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No closeout disposition step for federal records outside the enclave
treatment_plan: Closeout disposition checklist
